entries.claim: The plans explicitly leave the ROADMAP success criterion requiring GH-233, GH-232, and GH-218 to trace through REQUIREMENTS rows unserved.
entries.failure_scenario: All four plans can complete while REQUIREMENTS.md still says "No cycle open," its live Traceability table remains empty, and every plan declares an empty requirements list. The three issues therefore cannot trace to Phase 1 as the ROADMAP requires; the plan even acknowledges that no task can satisfy this criterion.

entries.claim: Task 2 verification manufactures PLAN-2.md itself instead of exercising the /cad-plan --gaps coordinator behavior it claims to change.
entries.failure_scenario: The filename-resolution prose can identify PLAN-2.md while the spawn_planner prompt still directs the planner to overwrite PLAN.md—for example because the resolved target is not carried into the prompt. The verifier then manually creates PLAN-2.md, after which replay-check naturally returns it and both original hashes remain unchanged. Every stated check passes even though a real /cad-plan --gaps invocation still overwrites PLAN.md, leaving the gap invisible to progress.

entries.claim: The grep verification cannot reliably detect a surviving auto-resume claim at the targeted cad-progress frontmatter description.
entries.failure_scenario: The negative pattern only catches the literal forms "auto-resume," "auto-resumes," and "auto resume," so an equivalent stale claim such as "automatically resumes" survives. The positive grep still passes for skills/cad-progress/SKILL.md because the task states that the file already contains the unchanged objective "offers to resume." Thus the defective frontmatter can remain untouched while all of this task's prose checks pass.
